span.p:
Need a database for
a new system or feature

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Use PostgreSQL
(or your default).
Defer decision
for 6 months.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Evaluate specialized
database candidates
with measured workload

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Default answer: 'We will use
PostgreSQL and revisit this
decision in 6 months when
we have data.' Most teams
revisit and find they never
needed a different database.
